test_title: PYST 27: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Iyadurai Solomon was a great teacher because he __instilled__ in all the children a sense of their own worth.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'inculcate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined word is **Instilled.**
 
• **Instilled **gradually but firmly establish (an idea or attitude) in a person's mind, means&n
